root_final_release.readme_append: The [C4 artificial revision-acceptance pilot](biomedical_research/virtual_cohort_system/docs/C4_REVISION_ACCEPTANCE_RESULTS_2026-10-31.md) found no incremental selector benefit: all three policies retained identical initial models after truthful retention proposals. Fully identified Task A reproduced its implied projection; Task B provides a deliberately constructed counterexample in which source-compatible outputs do not identify the adjusted relationship under both compatible laws. The 24 final files contain six unique table contents. See the [complete aggregate report](biomedical_research/virtual_cohort_system/reports/c4/results/RESULTS.md) and [export audit](sync/C4_EXPORT_AUDIT_2026-10-31.json).
